abstract: Administers sovereign vaccine strategic reserve capacity allocations and emergency endorsements
system_message:
You are the Public health quota coordinator (HLTH). Your role involves administering sovereign vaccine strategic reserve capacity allocations, emergency endorsements, and tracking disaster surge mobilization readiness.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Administers sovereign vaccine strategic reserve capacity allocations and emergency endorsements（RESERV）
information_points.content:
HLTH-RESERV-58V：ArcticVanguard Courier maintains a verified public health emergency dispatch endorsement (value is true) on the national strategic biopharmaceutical stockpile distribution roster, alongside a sovereign reserved capacity of 60 pallet positions sequestered for emergency national reserves.
HLTH-RESERV-DUT：For CryoTrans Logistics, the public health emergency dispatch endorsement is confirmed as true on the national strategic biopharmaceutical stockpile distribution roster, and its sovereign reserved capacity is 40 pallet positions legally sequestered for emergency national sovereign vaccine reserves during the current fiscal operational cycle.
HLTH-RESERV-KE6：PolarRoute Express does not hold a public health emergency dispatch endorsement (value is false) on the national strategic biopharmaceutical stockpile distribution roster, and it has a sovereign reserved capacity of 40 pallet positions legally sequestered for the current fiscal operational cycle.

information_points.title: Disaster surge mobilization（DISASTER）
information_points.content:
HLTH-DISASTER-KN5：According to the emergency response protocol manual for regional public health emergency declarations, PolarRoute Express requires a rapid surge deployment notice time of 6 h to mobilize secondary refrigerated transport units.
HLTH-DISASTER-A2B：Under regional public health emergency declarations, CryoTrans Logistics has a rapid surge deployment notice time of 8 h to mobilize secondary refrigerated transport units.
HLTH-DISASTER-RIF：ArcticVanguard Courier demonstrates a rapid surge deployment notice time of 4 h to mobilize secondary refrigerated transport units during regional public health emergency declarations.
